# Appendix

```{=latex}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25}
```

| **Column name** | **Description** | **Data type** |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Trip ID | Unique identifier for the trip | Text |
| Taxi ID | Unique identifier for the taxi | Text |
| Trip Start Timestamp | When the trip started, rounded to the nearest 15 minutes | Timestamp |
| Trip End Timestamp | When the trip ended, rounded to the nearest 15 minutes | Timestamp |
| Trip Seconds | Duration of the trip in seconds | Number |
| Trip Miles | Distance of the trip in miles | Number |
| Pickup Census Tract | Census tract where the trip began | Text |
| Dropoff Census Tract | Census tract where the trip ended | Text |
| Pickup Community Area | Community area where the trip began | Number |
| Dropoff Community Area | Community area where the trip ended | Number |
| Fare | Fare for the trip | Number |
| Tips | Tip for the trip; cash tips are generally not recorded | Number |
| Tolls | Tolls for the trip | Number |
| Extras | Extra charges for the trip | Number |
| Trip Total | Total cost, the sum of fare, tips, tolls and extras | Number |
| Payment Type | Type of payment for the trip | Text |
| Company | Taxi company | Text |
| Pickup Centroid Latitude | Latitude of the pickup area centroid | Number |
| Pickup Centroid Longitude | Longitude of the pickup area centroid | Number |
| Pickup Centroid Location | Location of the pickup area centroid | Point |
| Dropoff Centroid Latitude | Latitude of the dropoff area centroid | Number |
| Dropoff Centroid Longitude | Longitude of the dropoff area centroid | Number |
| Dropoff Centroid Location | Location of the dropoff area centroid | Point |

: Field dictionary of the raw trip records. {#tbl-fielddict}

| **Flag** | **Description** | **Scope** | **Rows** | **Share** |
|:---|:---|:---|---:|---:|
| end_before_start | Trip end is earlier than trip start | hard, all aggregations | 98 | 0.00% |
| extreme_seconds | Trip duration exceeds 3 hours | hard, all aggregations | 14,438 | 0.10% |
| extreme_miles | Trip distance exceeds 100 miles | hard, all aggregations | 1,202 | 0.01% |
| invalid_seconds | Trip duration is zero | soft, duration and speed features | 201,927 | 1.36% |
| zero_miles | Trip distance is zero; still counted as a demand event | soft, distance and speed features | 1,294,820 | 8.75% |
| extreme_total | Trip total exceeds \$200 | soft, revenue aggregations | 9,541 | 0.06% |
| missing_pickup_area | Pickup community area is missing | spatial, community-area datasets | 413,385 | 2.79% |

: Validation rules and thresholds. {#tbl-validation}

| **Resolution** | **Average area** | **Rough scale** |
|:---------------|-----------------:|:----------------|
| r4 | 1,770.3 km² | Large city or metro region |
| r5 | 252.9 km² | City district |
| r6 | 36.1 km² | Large neighborhood |
| r7 | 5.2 km² | Neighborhood |
| r8 | 0.7 km² | A few city blocks |

| **Feature** | **Group** | **Type** | **Meaning** |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `demand_count` | target | int | trips originating in a cell and 4h bucket (prediction target) |
| `hour_sin` / `hour_cos` | calendar | float | time of day, cyclical encoding |
| `dow_sin` / `dow_cos` | calendar | float | day of week, cyclical encoding |
| `month_sin` / `month_cos` | calendar | float | month, cyclical encoding |
| `is_weekend` | calendar | int (0/1) | weekend flag |
| `cell_lat` | spatial | float | cell centroid latitude |
| `cell_lon` | spatial | float | cell centroid longitude |
| `dist_to_loop_mi` | spatial | float | miles to the downtown core |
| `dist_to_ohare_mi` | spatial | float | miles to O'Hare |
| `dist_to_midway_mi` | spatial | float | miles to Midway |
| `temp_4h` | weather | float | average temperature (°F) |
| `rain_4h` | weather | float | total rainfall |
| `snow_4h` | weather | float | total snowfall |
| `precip_4h` | weather | float | total precipitation |
| `wind_speed_4h` | weather | float | average wind speed |
| `weather_code_4h` | weather | int (categorical) | most severe weather code |
